title: Kisse karu ilteja tere siwa Fatima
body:
Kisse karun ilteja tere siwa Fatima, Koi nahi aasra tere siwa Fatima.
Hadh hai yeh takreem ki baap ne tazeem ki.
Kisko mila martaba tere siwa Fatima.
Zoujaye Shere Khuda binte Rasule Khuda, Kiska hai yeh martaba tere siwa Fatima.
Banu ka woh noujawan aur woh zakhmi sina, Kiska kaleja chida tere siwa Fatima.
Maqtale Karbobala phulon se tera basa, Kiska chaman yun luta tere siwa Fatima.
Chadare Zainab jo thi chadare tatheer thi, Chin gayi kiski rida tere siwa Fatima.
Kufe ke bazaar mein sham ke darbaar mein, Kiska khula sar raha tere siwa Fatima.
Sadqe se Hasnain ke wa karo uqde mere, Koun kare rad bala tere siwa Fatima...
